method: All rows re-score frozen 8-bit PNG output against exactly the same native Apple crop, current glass mask and eroded icon mask. No re-fitting. Glass excludes icon/exterior; icon score only where independently rendered. Lower RMSE is better; higher SSIM is better. Not percentage similarity.

limits: Common output scoring removes score-method/mask differences but does not remove differences in how earlier inputs were reconstructed.
Early icons copied from reference are deliberately not counted as zero-error icon success.
Pass02/03 glass unchanged; source-image identification and title offsets recorded.
Unscored lab/physics work has no measured Apple-reference reconstruction score; none is invented.
Same-frame pixel calibration, not independent-scene or temporal validation. SSIM is not a literal matching percentage.
